name: js-sdk
description: Rollfuse JS/TS SDK family: contracts, evaluation-core, the server/browser/React SDKs built on them, and an OpenFeature provider.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts -w packages/evaluation-core -w packages/sdk -w packages/sdk-browser -w packages/sdk-react -w packages/openfeature-provider
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/contracts -w packages/evaluation-core -w packages/sdk -w packages/sdk-browser -w packages/sdk-react -w packages/openfeature-provider
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/evaluation-core -w packages/sdk -w packages/sdk-browser -w packages/sdk-react -w packages/openfeature-provider --if-present
